summary: All three registered questions are answered, so I reselected onto the history/compaction mechanism: registered the new sourced question @q_snapshot_delta_underflow, noting that shouldSnapshot compares the log store's LastIndex with the cached last snapshot index using unsigned arithmetic, so a node whose store was emptied while its snapshot index is high (compaction after a snapshot install or a user restore) yields an underflowed delta and a spurious positive verdict. Recorded it as a source-only interpretation (explained, no defect asserted) with limitations bounding the consequence to an extra snapshot attempt rather than any safety effect, plus a discriminator that drives a real node into the emptied-store state and compares against a control node whose store still holds entries past the snapshot.
